notes.title: Game Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a fresh update to the The Face Horror Game Demo, and we’re excited to share what’s new:

✨ Improved Animation Fidelity
Characters now move more fluidly and expressively — making every scene feel more alive and immersive.

🖱️ Mouse Cursor Fix
We’ve fixed the mouse cursor issue! It now properly hides during gameplay for a cleaner and more immersive experience.

⏱️ Better Pacing
We've adjusted the timing and flow of key scenes to improve the overall gameplay experience — making it more engaging from start to finish.

Thank you for all your feedback so far! This update brings us one step closer to the full vision of the game. 💀👁️

Download the updated demo, and let us know what you think!
Your input means everything and helps us keep making the game better.

Stay spooky,
Scary Creepy Pasta
